newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up on good sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up on good sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended up on Monday led by Pudong property shares with market sentiment strong, brokers said.
Both the A and B indices rose despite a renewed warning from the official media that there were signs of overheating on the stock markets, they said.
But trading volume on the B market was normal with investors more cautious as a result of the current high levels of many of the A shares, brokers said.
The B index rose 0.431 points or 0.59 percent to 73.925 points on volume of 18.47 million worth $9.92 million.

"Institutional buying in selective stocks pushed the index steadily up, but follow-up buying was limited because investors are concerned about overheating in the domestic A share market," one broker said.
Another broker said the index was likely to move up further in the short term, but only slowly given the cautious mood.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded, with 18 up, four flat and 20 down.
Huangshan Tourism Development was the star on expectations of good prospects, jumping $0.032 or 5.61 percent to $0.602 on volume of 1.2 million shares.
Real estate developer Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development traded the most on domestic buying, up $0.022 or 2.14 percent to $1.050 on volume of 1.6 million shares.

The Shanghai A share index ended at its highest level for four years despite a warning from the securities authorities about the risks of market volatility. Market sentiment was bullish with fresh capital continuing to flow into the market, brokers said.
The index put on 16.395 points or 1.24 percent to 1,338.058 points on volume of 945.2 million shares worth 11.8 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index gained 49.336 points or 1.40 percent to 3,572.409 points.
Shanghai Hainiao Electronics was the star on speculative buying, surging 0.95 yuan or 10.05 percent to 10.40 on volume of 3.4 million shares.
